upstream_pin.version_boundary: Only Diesel v2.3.14 with the planned PostgreSQL feature and Rust 1.86.0 fixture is scoped; other Diesel versions, backends, feature graphs, migration state and runtime schemas are excluded.

constructs.invariant: The normal table! and joinable! declarations are source expectations until T08 compiler facts and a database oracle agree.
Rust identifiers differ from SQL identifiers when #[sql_name] is present; do not infer physical names from tokens alone.
An ordered composite primary key cannot be reduced to a single id field; do not fabricate joinable! for composite foreign keys.
An unqualified table! may resolve to different physical schemas per PostgreSQL connection search_path.

steps: Verify the annotated v2.3.14 tag, resolved commit, six source digests, Rust toolchain and locked Cargo dependency graph before compiling fixtures.
Have T08 compile and expand each normal and counterexample Rust fixture under exact features; capture diagnostics and source provenance, including #[sql_name], key order and association references.

Compare T08 facts with a disposable PostgreSQL catalog and explicit tenant_a/tenant_b connections; test schema.rs versus migration drift and search_path resolution without inferring a runtime schema from source alone.
Require T16 independent read, T19 mutation review, T01 contract projection, packed-artifact consumption and T20 isolation before any support or certification claim.

limits: These Rust files are hand-authored planning fixtures, not upstream source copies, compiled models or runtime evidence.
No Rust compiler, Cargo restore, macro expansion, Diesel connection or PostgreSQL oracle was run in this scope.
